design_context: Marketing / Landing Page for Premium Pilates Studio (Urban Spa)

visual_enhancers.shapes: fluid organic blobs in background to mimic the veil koi (carpa véu)

grids_layouts.hero: Full height, centered content, abstract fluid background
grids_layouts.reception: Asymmetrical split 50/50, large image overlapping text box
grids_layouts.pilates_studio: Bento-style 2-photo grid, one tall, one square with overlapping text
grids_layouts.oasis: Full width image background with central glassmorphism card for text
grids_layouts.massage: Cozy side-by-side with organic shape crop on image
grids_layouts.plans: 3-column grid of glassmorphic cards with metallic blue borders on hover
grids_layouts.footer: Large padding, centered logo, floating CTA

components.button: Pill-shaped, metallic blue gradient background, soft glow, hover scale up
components.cards: Glassmorphism, 1px white/10 border, inner padding p-8
components.navigation: Sticky, crystal glass effect, z-50 (no transparent backgrounds)

motion.reveals: Framer motion staggered fade-up for all text and cards
motion.background: Slow pulsing and translating organic SVG blobs to mimic water/koi movement

hero_bg.description: Deep blue and purple flowing shapes abstract for hero section

oasis.description: Indoor green wall rocks and plants

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark mode exclusively as the base for this premium spa site. The primary backgrounds should be #050B14 or #0A1128.
Implement fluid, organic shapes (blobs or SVG waves) using CSS animations or Framer Motion to mimic the 'veil koi' concept.
Do NOT use pure Inter for text. Use Playfair Display for headings (import from Google Fonts) and Outfit for body.
Ensure all text layered over images or backgrounds is accessible (min 4.5:1 ratio). Use glassmorphism or dark gradients if needed.
The primary CTA is the WhatsApp booking button. Make sure there is a floating WhatsApp button in the bottom right corner.
Use lucide-react for icons (e.g. WhatsApp, Checkmarks for plans, Instagram).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Build the UI directly in HTML/Tailwind without relying purely on Shadcn for the marketing layout, as it requires asymmetry and overlapping grid cells.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the whole app. Use proper grid layouts and left-align text where appropriate.
Do not apply `transition: all` as it breaks transforms.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., py-24, gap-12).
Ensure hover states exist for all interactive elements.
